# Test: grove add --name rejects path separators and dot directory names before git calls
mkdir outside
cd outside

! exec grove add --name nested/dir feature/slash-name-test
stderr '--name must be a single directory name'

! exec grove add --name 'nested\dir' feature/backslash-name-test
stderr '--name must be a single directory name'

! exec grove add --name . feature/dot-name-test
stderr '--name must be a single directory name'

! exec grove add --name .. feature/dot-dot-name-test
stderr '--name must be a single directory name'
